Tara Nguyen: morning — async standup
Tara Nguyen: yesterday I landed the kernel slotting patch and ran a small microbench; batch packing looks ~12% better p95 on short seqs.
Samir Patel: nice! which microbench? link?
Tara Nguyen: https://git.internal/r/redwood/bench/commit/abcd123
Tara Nguyen: bench command I used:
```
./bench --model=redwood-small --seq=64 --concurrency=8 --runs=200
```
Jordan Lee: saw a regression on long seqs p99 after the slotting change, likely due to prefetch ordering; reproducer in #repro
Samir Patel: can you paste the p99 numbers?
Jordan Lee: before: 210ms, after: 430ms
Tara Nguyen: ack, I think the microbatcher is coalescing differently; I'm debugging eviction timing.
bench-bot: microbench summary — 2026-03-19T07:12Z — redwood-small seq64: p50 23ms p95 58ms p99 210ms
Matt O'Rourke: heads up — planning a canary for kernel-2.3 tomorrow, hold off on config flips until canary is green
Priya Shah: ops noted. Matt who is owning canary?
Matt O'Rourke: I'll kick it off, need one reviewer on the rollout mapping (Samir?)
Samir Patel: can do. also +1 on adding a quick KV-cache warmup in the smoke script. it shaved ~8% latency in my run.
Tara Nguyen: great — I'll add warmup step to the PR. Blocker: the CI flaky test `batcher_integration::prefetch_race` still fails ~1/20; need help reproducing locally
Jordan Lee: I can attempt a local stress with `--race` shim, sending a short script in DM
Tara Nguyen: thanks. Today: reproduce/regress, add warmup, follow-up bench, then iterate on prefetch ordering.
Samir Patel: thumbs up. please @eng-oncall if you see infra OOMs.
Matt O'Rourke: ping me when the canary is scheduled so I can watch traces.
Priya Shah: FYI I'll rotate on-call next week so tag me for postmortem if needed.
Tara Nguyen: thanks team :thumbsup:
